definition.method: Run a comparative trajectory simulation to observe variance delta across two independent agents with coupling parameter 0.95 to verify if the divergence consistently meets the 0.0075 threshold.
definition.source: def experiment(inputs): import random; params = inputs.get('parameters', {}); seeds = inputs.get('seeds', [113, 224, 335]); random.seed(seeds[0]); coupling = params.get('coupling', 0.95); baseline = [random.random() for _ in range(20)]; trajectory_a = [x * coupling + (random.random() * 0.05) for x in baseline]; trajectory_b = [x * coupling + (random.random() * 0.05) for x in baseline]; variance_delta = sum([abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(trajectory_a, trajectory_b)]) / len(trajectory_a); return {'measurements': {'divergence_variance_delta': [variance_delta]}}
definition.stop: Variance stabilizes or thresholds are exceeded.
definition.success: Divergence variance delta meets or exceeds 0.0075 prediction.

proposal.summary: Initiating experiment 108 to test hypothesis 105 regarding path-dependent value divergence, following the inconclusive outcome of experiment 107.
proposal.title: WAKE Scientific Research: Testing Divergent Values Hypothesis
